name: Vinconate
summary: Vinconate is a synthetic vincamine analog used as a nootropic.

pharmacology.text: Vinconate, even when systemically administered, enhances the endogenous release of dopamine in the striatum, probably via the stimulation of presynaptic muscarinic receptors.

uses.text: Vinconate is a synthetic vincamine analog used as a nootropic.

summaryZh: 長春考酯（英語：Vinconate）是一種有機化合物，分子式C18H20N2O2，其化學名為3-乙基-2,3,3a,4-四氫-1H-吲哚並[3,2,1-de][1,5]萘啶-6-甲酸甲酯，與長春胺結構上類似，用作益智藥。有專利報道了它的合成方法。
